definitions.explanation: Describes a person who pursues one course of action with unwavering dedication, without being swayed by distractions. Can be positive (sincere, devoted) or mildly negative (inflexible).

examples.japanese: {一本気|いっぽんぎ}な⟦{性格|せいかく}→性格：03371_seikaku⟧だ。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{一本気|いっぽんぎ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{融通|ゆうずう}→融通：10914_yuuzuu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{利|き}かない→利く：11845_kiku⟧。
{一本気|いっぽんぎ}な⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{一度|いちど}→一度：01312_ichido⟧⟦{決|き}めたら→決める：00858_kimeru⟧⟦{最後|さいご}→最後：01413_saigo⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{貫|つらぬ}く→貫く：18728_tsuranuku⟧。
examples.english: She's so single-minded that once she decides something, she sees it through to the end.

notes:
Describes someone who pursues one thing wholeheartedly without wavering. Can be positive (dedicated, sincere) or slightly negative (stubborn, inflexible), depending on context. The word literally suggests having one (⟦{一本|いっぽん}→一本：08888_ippon⟧) core spirit (⟦{気|き}→気：02199_ki⟧).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {一本気|いっぽんぎ}な⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧: a single-minded person
- {一本気|いっぽんぎ}な⟦{性格|せいかく}→性格：03371_seikaku⟧: a straightforward personality
- {一本気|いっぽんぎ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{進|すす}む→進む：01225_susumu⟧: to push forward single-mindedly

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{一途|いちず}→一途：18242_ichizu⟧: devoted, single-hearted — usually positive; often used about romantic devotion
- ⟦{頑固|がんこ}→頑固：06643_ganko⟧: stubborn — negative connotation; emphasizes unwillingness to change
- {真|ま}っ{直|す}ぐ: straight, honest — focuses on being straightforward and upright
